items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I was interested in that picture that you loaned to Al Rose, which he wants to have in a book.

ctx.x: It was a clarinet player, but I lost trace of him, who he was. I just can't remember him.

I was interested in that picture that you loaned to Al Rose, which he wants to have in a book. I have those pictures of Al Rose here now. I've been going over those pictures. I might be able to find it, but can you remember now who else was in that band, that picture? Tuxedo band? Yes, in the tuxedo. Oh, yeah.
I could name most all of them. It was Eddie Mariah, Joan Mariah, Lawrence Mariah.
